content.title: About
content.content: Yogurt NS is a smooth dairy product made from whole cow’s milk with live probiotic cultures. It has a creamy texture and a mild tangy flavor, without added sugars or flavorings.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Yogurt NS is produced using a traditional fermentation process where milk is cultured at a controlled temperature.
The ingredient list includes only milk and live cultures Lactobacillus bulgaricus and Streptococcus thermophilus, with no artificial sweeteners.
Yogurt retains most of the milk’s nutrients, including calcium, protein, and B‑vitamins.
It is often used as a base for sauces, desserts, and smoothies.

items.title: Supports gut microbiota
items.content: Live probiotic cultures promote the growth of beneficial bacteria, improving digestion and immune function.

items.title: Source of calcium and protein
items.content: Yogurt provides calcium for bone health and high‑quality milk protein for muscle maintenance.

items.title: Moderate fat content
items.content: Plain NS yogurt has a moderate fat level, making it suitable for balanced diets.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: It contains riboflavin (B2) and vitamin B12, which are important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Improved lactose tolerance
items.content: Fermentation partially breaks down lactose, making the product easier to digest for people with mild lactose intolerance.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to casein or whey may react to yogurt.

items.title: Live culture viability
items.content: If stored above the recommended temperature, probiotic counts can decline, reducing the product’s benefits.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some yogurt varieties may contain added salt; those monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Yogurt NS can be enjoyed on its own, mixed with granola or fruit, used as a base for dressings, sauces, and smoothies, or incorporated into baked goods to add moisture and flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep yogurt refrigerated at 1 °C–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 5–7 days. Do not freeze, as the texture may change.
